paper_title: LaSQuE Improved Zero-Shot Classification from Explanations Through   Quantifier Modeling and Curriculum Learning
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the relationship between “Exp. Length” and “Attention Weights”. The horizontal axis represents “Exp. Length” with categories labeled 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, and 35, displayed in ascending order. The vertical axis represents “Attention Weights” with a linear scale ranging from 0.20 to 0.45, with tick marks at 0.25, 0.30, 0.35, 0.40, and 0.45. There are seven blue bars, one for each “Exp. Length” value. The bar corresponding to “Exp. Length” of 5 has an approximate height of 0.34, while the bar representing “Exp. Length” of 15 reaches approximately 0.42. The bar representing “Exp. Length” of 20 has approximately the same height as the bar for 15, at 0.42; the bar for “Exp. Length” of 30 has a height of about 0.34, roughly the same as that for “Exp. Length” 5. No bars are visibly emphasized or annotated.
